caller.voice: His wife, worried, in casual Singapore English. She knows only what she has seen: her husband is 58 and has had heavy, squeezing chest pain for about 30 minutes while watching TV, going to his left arm and jaw, and he is sweating a lot. He has a heart problem, and took one spray of his GTN before the crew came.

answers.location: Blk 1xx Bedok North Rd, #05-xx. Fifth floor.
answers.whatHappened: My husband, 58. He was watching TV, then got chest pain. He say very heavy, like something squeezing. Half an hour already. The pain go to his left arm and his jaw, and he sweating a lot. He got heart problem, he took one spray of his GTN already.
answers.conscious: Conscious, he can talk, but the pain very bad.
answers.icAndMeds: OK, I get his IC and his heart medicine ready for you.

patient.name: Ahmad bin Salleh
patient.voice: Worried and in pain. Speaks in full sentences, a little breathless, and stops when the pain squeezes.
patient.chiefComplaint: My chest very heavy, like something squeezing. Half an hour already. The pain go to my left arm and my jaw.

lines.feelingNow: Breathing a bit easier now. But the chest pain still the same, still heavy.
lines.fall: No, I never fall. I was on the sofa the whole time.
lines.hitHead: No, I never hit my head.
lines.lungHistory: No, no asthma, no lung problem. Only my heart problem.
lines.verbal: Ahmad bin Salleh. I'm at home, in Bedok.
lines.motor: OK, both arms up, like this.
lines.position: Let me lie flat on the sofa like this. I want to lie down.
lines.bpScreen: No shunt, no fistula. Never had any chest operation.
lines.ic: My IC is in my pocket, here.
lines.convinced: OK, I sit up. Yes, easier to breathe like this.

hazards: GTN spray on the side table beside the patient

loc.response: Yes, I can hear you. My chest very pain.

spine.dtbl: No deformities, tenderness, bruises or lacerations

circulation.pulse: Radial pulse present, fast and strong

investigation.auscultation: Air entry equal, breath sounds clear

ecg.reading: Sinus tachycardia about 104, ST elevation in II, III and aVF
